title: The Mughals Laying of Seige Around (Banda Singh)

blocks.text: At the end Banda resolves not to abandon those still with him, saying in essence bhali buri tum sang nibahon: in good or bad, he will remain bound to their fate.
He now chooses endurance over escape, and the page falls into the stillness before the final assault as the Turks realize how vulnerable the camp has become.
This closing promise is the anchor because it turns the page from argument and blame into fatal resolution.
